description: This file contains unit tests for the PhotosHandler class, verifying permission handling, JSON validation, and payload retrieval. It also defines a fake data source for testing purposes.

classes.name: PhotosHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for PhotosHandler, extending NodeHandlerRobolectricTest to run Robolectric-based Android unit tests.

classes.name: FakePhotosDataSource
classes.description: A fake implementation of PhotosDataSource used for testing, providing controlled responses.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly responds with an error when permission is not granted.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Tests that the handler rejects invalid JSON input.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest_returnsPayload
methods.description: Tests that the handler successfully returns a payload with photo data when permission is granted and input is valid.
